name: Calisto Queensland
source:
Species: Fish

Calisto is both stern and a joker. He has a tendency to be overbearing when it comes to watching out for those he cares about, but he generally prefers to be lighthearted and make others smile. He spent most of his life in the ocean, so he's still adjusting to life on land. He works as a bartender at Lady's Bar.

"Got somefin' on your mind?"

[From [url=http://www.duenkhy.com/]official site[/url]]
